title: Simulate one EWSR1-FLI1 RNA-seq sample with ground-truth breakpoints
context: M0 data task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark: produce the first end-to-end-usable simulated sample so the smoke harness has real input. The sample is fully simulated (no patient data) with documented ground-truth breakpoints, satisfying the open/simulated-only guardrail. It conforms to the canonical FusionCall ground-truth model from schema-003 and ships with a machine-readable manifest and provenance.
objective: Simulate one EWSR1-FLI1 RNA-seq sample with an exact ground-truth breakpoint manifest, conforming to the schema-003 data model, ready for the smoke harness.
acceptanceCriteria: One simulated EWSR1-FLI1 RNA-seq sample generated with reads and a machine-readable ground-truth manifest (genes, exact breakpoints, support counts).
Manifest conforms to the canonical ground-truth record from schema-003; license CC-BY-4.0/CC0 stated.
Generation method and seed recorded so the sample is reproducible; provenance recorded (no patient data).
output: data/sim/ewsr1-fli1-sample-001/ — simulated reads + ground-truth manifest + provenance.
